summary: Iteration 2 (new features) end-to-end tested. Backend: 27/27 pytest pass (existing 20 regression + 7 new in test_iter2.py covering KB seed, smart RAG BPJS answer, smart LLM router 'pengen ketemu dokter' → booking flow, workflow config GET/PUT persistence, /appointments/send-reminders returning {sent,total_due}, handoff keyword). Frontend Playwright: Knowledge page lists all 4 seeded docs; Workflow page renders 4 module toggles + router controls (toggle-llm-router, wf-fallback, wf-welcome-extra) + all 6 intent editor cards each with wf-name/action/menukey/keywords/examples/enabled/del + wf-add-intent works (6→7) + wf-save-btn persists an edited intent name across reload; Settings 'Lanjutan' toggle-reminders toggles+persists after settings-save-btn + reload; Appointments send-reminders-btn triggers POST and reminder-msg shows 'Terkirim 0 dari 2 pengingat H-1.' (0 sent expected, WA gateway not connected); Live WS toast fires on handoff webhook — toast-container shows '🔔 ToastTest butuh staf' and notif bell count incremented (6→7). Sound not verified in headless.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/whatsapp/webhook response omits the 'intent' field even though workflow.handle_incoming computes it — surfacing it would help external gateways/tests. Not a bug, but useful.

Router LLM prompt uses `hash(text) % 100000` as conversation-id for the router LLM call — this is fine but shares the conversation store with actual chats; consider a dedicated session/tag prefix to avoid future ambiguity.

Settings PUT still accepts arbitrary Dict without Pydantic validation for the new workflow.intents payload — malformed intents (e.g., missing 'action') would silently persist and break workflow at runtime. Add validation.

reminders.run_reminders uses gw.send_message and only marks reminder_sent=True on r.get('ok'); with WA gateway down every run will retry the same due appointments indefinitely — acceptable, but consider a retry cap or last_attempt_at field.
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 conversations via webhook during tests (fresh JIDs). One TEST_intent_iter2 workflow intent added and cleaned up. Intent-0 name edited then restored. Reminders toggle flipped and restored. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (27 tests, ~14s). Iter2-specific tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter2.py. Frontend nav testids Indonesian (nav-koneksi/percakapan/janji-temu/knowledge/workflow/pengaturan/dashboard). Webhook /api/whatsapp/webhook response shape: {ok, handoff, replies:[]} — no 'intent' key exposed. Live WS at wss://<host>/api/ws?token=<jwt>, emits {handoff:true, patient_name, preview} on staff-needed events.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. WA gateway is intentionally disconnected — send-reminders returns sent=0 as expected.
